title: Forgeborne Odyssey
description: This project adds metallurgy and technology features to Minecraft, simulating industrial processes from the Bronze Age to the Nuclear Age with metalworking mechanics, tools, weapons, and armor.
body: Forgeborne Odyssey is a comprehensive metallurgy and technology mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that simulates authentic cold-forging processes from raw material extraction to finished products. It features a complete crafting chain including natural metal generation (copper, silver, gold) with realistic geological distribution, fire pit heating and softening mechanics, multi-stage anvil forging (stretching, bending, slotting, carving), and diverse output categories encompassing weapons, tools, armor, accessories, and building materials. The mod integrates quality systems, dynamic durability, JEI compatibility, and an in-game guidebook to deliver an immersive pre-industrial metalworking experience.
